text: Right, I've been sat on hold on and off for ages and the callback never came so I'm trying this instead. My stepson is 3. He's been running a temperature since yesterday afternoon, 39.2°C on the ear thermometer about twenty minutes ago. He keeps telling me his throat hurts, he points at it and pulls a face when he swallows, but he IS drinking, he's had most of a beaker of juice and some water tonight so I'm not worried on that front. His mum's working nights so it's just me. Before anyone asks, I've already checked him all over for a rash. There's a couple of little red marks on his arm but I did the glass thing and they went completely pale and disappeared, so that's fine. I'd just like someone to actually tell me whether he needs seeing tonight or whether calpol and bed is enough, because I'd rather not drag him out at midnight for nothing.
